inner_splits.kind: purged_kfold_splits inside each outer training set

parameters.logistic: StandardScaler on numeric features, one-hot on regime codes, lbfgs, max_iter=10000
parameters.mcnemar: exact, two-sided, model vs each baseline on the same months
parameters.brier: multiclass form: sum over classes of (p_k - 1[y=k])^2, averaged over months; brier_binary is the usual binary score for direction
parameters.auc: binary for direction; macro one-vs-rest over classes defined in the sample for regime

trials.note: the deflated Sharpe counts every (target, feature set, model, hyperparameter configuration) combination, including the regime target's, which trades nothing

economic.rule: long when P(up) > 0.5, else flat; held to the next decision date

deflated_sharpe.note: P(true Sharpe > threshold) after deflating for n_trials; per-period (monthly) Sharpe, Pearson kurtosis

verdict.rule: beats = paired 95% stationary-bootstrap interval of the difference above 0 and exact McNemar p < 0.05 (classification); paired Sharpe-difference interval above 0 (trading)
verdict.statement: No model beats every baseline on accuracy. No direction strategy beats buy-and-hold on Sharpe (paired interval includes or is below 0).
